planets.name: TOI-1201 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-1201 with a 2.49-day year, found in 2021.

text.card: TOI-1201 b was found in 2021 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-1201. Its orbit and size follow Kossakowski et al. 2021's fit, the archive's default.
